title: Uwushikamye yubaka agakiza .
intro: Uwo muntu yari umuntu afise ukwihangana gukomeye be n’ukwemera kudahungabana, yarihevye imyaka itagira uko ingana akora ubutumwa bw’Imana, ahanganye n’ugusuzugurwa n’ukwangwa bidahera. Inkuru yabo ni ikimenyamenya gikomeye c’ukwizera mu gihe c’ukutemera gukomeye cane, kigashika ku ntumbero y’ikintu gihambaye cahinduye isi.
clues: Nahevye igihe kirekire cane c’ubuzima bwanje mpamagara abantu banje gusenga Allah.
Abantu banje barantwengera mw’ijigo, banshinja amakosa agaragara n’ubusazi.
Nategetswe kwubaka ikintu kimeze nk’ikidasanzwe ku kibano canje kitagira inkengera.
Bakeyi gusa ni bo bemeye maze barafatanya nanje n’umuryango wanje muri iyo nyubakwa idasanzwe.
Natwaye ikiremwa cose kizima mu bwato bibiri bibiri bibiri, nk’uko vyategetswe na Allah.
Umwuzure munini warapfutse isi, urokora abo twari kumwe mu bwato bwanje gusa, mu gihe umuhungu wanje bwite yapfuye kubera ukutemera kwiwe.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
